cards.taskTitle: Big international airport · 看图材料
cards.imageAlt: Big international airport，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioTextZh: 你可以描述一下这张图吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes. I can. The picture shows the outside view of an airport terminal.
I guess it is Beijing Daxing International Airport.
This is a complicated airport with many stands and runways.
cards.referenceTextZh:
好的。这是一张机场航站楼的外观图。
我猜它是北京大兴国际机场。
这是一个复杂机场，有很多的停机位和跑道。

cards.audioText: Compared with small airports, what are the advantages and disadvantages of big international airports?
cards.audioTextZh: 与小机场相比，大型国际机场的优缺点是什么？
cards.referenceText:
Advantages: there are more advanced facilities and gates.
They will meet take-off and landing requirements for large aircraft.
Disadvantages: traffic congestion and air traffic control are easier to occur.
The complicated airport layout make it easier for pilots to get confused.
cards.referenceTextZh:
优点：有更先进的设施和更多的停机位。
它们能够满足大型飞机的起降要求。
缺点：容易发生交通拥堵和流控。
复杂的机场布局容易使飞行员困惑。

cards.audioText: Can you name some special equipment in an airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能说出机场里的专业设备吗？
cards.referenceText:
There are some special equipment used in an airport.
For example, runway lighting equipment, bird-scaring equipment, tug, navigation equipment, like NDB and VOR.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机场配备了很多专业设备。如：跑道灯光设备、驱鸟设备、拖车、导航设备，比如：NDB和VOR。
